chunks: Say: 'Shall I tell you who are the greatest in loss in terms of deeds?'

key_terms.الأَخْسَرِينَ: The greatest in loss or the most deprived

ai.seo_question: Who are considered the greatest losers in terms of their deeds according to the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often interpreted as identifying those who strive in worldly pursuits or even religious rituals but lack true *ma'rifah* (gnosis) and alignment with the Ahl al-Bayt, rendering their deeds 'the most lost' in terms of eternal value. The term *akhasarin* (most lost) emphasizes a comparative degree, suggesting that while others may lose some benefit, this group loses everything despite their apparent diligence. This highlights the Shia emphasis on the quality of intention and doctrinal correctness over mere quantity of action.
